digest.component_or_area: CI/CD workflows and test coverage sweep
propositions: The Verified gate matrix must be extended with scheduled-only, non-gating coverage for Python 3.14 (latest stable), 3.15 (dev), 3.14t (free-threaded), Windows, full macOS suite, and dependency lower-bounds, without adding hot-path latency to Gerrit verification.

Five new scheduled/dispatch-only jobs must be appended to test.yml: sweep-interpreters (ubuntu + 3.14/3.15/3.14t with 3.14 locked), sweep-windows (windows-latest), sweep-macos-full (macos-latest), sweep-lower-bounds (3.11 + lowest-direct), and sweep-doc-links (external link checking); none can be a needs: dependency of merge-gating jobs.

The 3.14-stable and sweep-lower-bounds jobs must NOT set REBAR_REQUIRE_EXTRAS to avoid triggering hard-error imports for uninstalled extras, whereas pre-release and Windows jobs must be non-blocking (continue-on-error: true).
All sweep pytest jobs must carry --timeout=600 --timeout-method=thread and be listed in EXCLUDED_JOBS in scripts/check_verify_gate_parity.py; existing CI-parity contract tests must remain green.
The 3.14 cell must install the committed uv.lock via uv sync --locked to test pure interpreter compatibility against the gate's exact dependency set, with zero genuine failures on locked deps.
The sweep-doc-links job must pin lychee-action to v2.9.0 commit SHA and use the confirmed fail: false input; the shared reusable _build-and-test.yml and Verified gate matrix remain unchanged.
